findings: Recipe digest duck_crest_puff (62dd5d74…): bilateral, coral-orange PLA, elliptical base 18x16x2 mm plus one backward-swept ellipsoid (rotated -18° about Z) and a front puff ellipsoid; single fused solid (solids=1).
Renders confirm positive-volume connection: both ellipsoids fully merge with the base and each other; no floating or disconnected geometry observed in perspective, -Y, +X or top views.
Silhouette is rounded and playful: the swept crest reads clearly in profile without sharp edges or intimidating shapes, matching the friendly brief.
Proportion is compact: added mass 4.0 g, bbox within roughly 28.5x16x13.5 mm, well inside the 80x80 zone and low total Z; nothing implausibly large or obstructive.
Camera and shell remain untouched; the part sits on the head-top datum behind the face, and the front view shows the face/camera unobstructed.
Motion sampling accepted in all 31 poses (min distance 15.7 mm to mjobj_geom_0, far above the 0.2 mm tolerance); no collisions reported.
Boundary rules hold: no material below Z=0, both features overlap the base, mirror-symmetric about Y=0 as declared.
Caveats per prototype scope: adhesive attachment curvature, ventilation, real print fit and walking performance remain unverified (interface_status=unverified, deployment_ready=false).
review.reason: Built candidate duck_crest_puff is host-eligible (proof and motion accepted) and the whole-robot plus close-up renders show a friendly, recognizable, well-attached rounded crest that preserves robot identity and camera view with no floating, oversized or obstructive geometry. It satisfies the brief as a printable personalization prototype, with attachment and motion performance correctly left as open items. Selecting this round.

selection.reason: 已审阅 duck_crest_puff (62dd5d74…) 的整机与近景渲染：圆角珊瑚橙色冠羽与顶部椭圆形基座完全融合，无浮动或孤立几何；轮廓圆润友好，无尖锐或笨重造型，符合简报要求。质量仅约4.0 g，包围盒约28.5x16x13.5 mm，位于80x80区域内；相机与外壳不受遮挡，正面视图面部清晰可见。31个姿态运动采样全部通过（最小间距15.7 mm，无碰撞），结构证明已接受，无低于Z=0的材料，双侧镜像按声明成立。粘接曲面适配、通风、真实打印与行走性能按原型范围保留为未验证项（interface_status=unverified, deployment_ready=false）。该轮为主机合格且经审查通过的候选，予以选定。
